visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A high-angle close-up of a finished culinary dish: a large, crispy, white-puffed tempura shell resembling a cloud, with a cooked shrimp visible inside. The dish sits on a white plate with a blue-checked cloth and a green shiso leaf. Bright studio lighting illuminates the scene. (2) Hands wearing white latex gloves are seen in a medium shot over a light wood table. They pour white salt, beige pepper powder, clear rice wine from a small glass, and white starch into a large glass mixing bowl. (3) The gloved hands mix the dry and liquid ingredients into a slurry, then add cleaned shrimp, white fish fillets, pink crab sticks, and oyster mushrooms, tossing them to coat. (4) A young man with short black hair, wearing a white t-shirt and a blue striped apron, appears from the chest up against a white brick background. He speaks to the camera, using hand gestures to explain the process. (5) In a close-up, circular translucent Vietnamese rice paper is placed on a cutting board. Shrimps are aligned on the sheet, and a second sheet of rice paper is pressed firmly on top to sandwich the ingredients. (6) Metal scissors are used to cut the double-layered rice paper into rectangular strips, separating the individual shrimp portions. (7) A small test piece of rice paper is dropped into hot oil in a black frying pan; it instantly expands and whitens. The shrimp parcels are then fried, quickly blooming into frilly, airy white structures. (8) In a small saucepan, brown liquid seasoning (mirin, soy sauce, water) comes to a rolling boil. Dried bonito flakes are added, and the heat is turned off immediately to steep. (9) The final shot returns to the close-up of the completed 'Cloud Tempura', highlighting the intricate, delicate texture of the fried rice paper and the vibrant orange of the shrimp tail.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Energetic acoustic guitar BGM with a steady drum beat kicks in. A male voice speaks with high arousal and a cheerful, inviting tone, introducing the concept of simple 'Cloud Tempura.' (2) Faint clinking of glass bowls accompanies the narrator listing ingredients. The speech rate is brisk but clear, characteristic of instructional videos. (3) Subtle squishing and stirring sounds as the seafood is marinated. The voice continues with an encouraging inflection. (4) Audible rustling of rice paper sheets. The BGM remains consistent in rhythm. The voice explains the technique of sandwiching the shrimp. (5) Sharp, metallic 'snip' sounds as the scissors cut the rice paper. A popping 'whoosh' transition SFX plays. The narrator mentions adding starch for better adhesion. (6) A loud, broadband sizzling sound dominates the mix as the rice paper enters the oil. The voice rises in pitch with excitement as he describes the 'blooming' effect. (7) Bubbling and simmering liquid sounds as the sauce ratio is explained (1:1:6). The tone is authoritative yet friendly. (8) The BGM continues through the final presentation as the narrator concludes the lesson, with a bright spectral finish.
